summary: High-level overview of the treasury settlement engine describing a seven-library pipeline (settlement processing, risk engine, reconciliation, event pipeline, regulatory compliance, notification/audit, and transaction validation) that processes settlement instructions through validation, risk checking, netting, and clearing stages with complex interdependencies and references nine detailed architecture documentation files.

likely_libraries.name: Settlement Processing
likely_libraries.reason: Core pipeline for validation, risk checking, netting, and clearing of settlement instructions

likely_libraries.name: Risk Engine
likely_libraries.reason: Maintains exposure windows and determines margin requirements for netting decisions

likely_libraries.name: Reconciliation Service
likely_libraries.reason: Detects breaks between internal ledger and counterparty acknowledgments from events

likely_libraries.name: Event Pipeline
likely_libraries.reason: Carries every state transition as typed events across the organization

likely_libraries.name: Regulatory Compliance
likely_libraries.reason: Watches for reportable thresholds and hold-period triggers with regulatory holds

likely_libraries.name: Notification and Audit
likely_libraries.reason: Persists full snapshots within latency budget and routes alerts to teams

likely_libraries.name: Transaction Validation
likely_libraries.reason: Performs upfront deduplication and schema validation
